issues.title: Employee brief inferred as analytics
issues.expected: Employee experience architecture with people, teams, onboarding, engagement and policies.
issues.actual: ANALYTICS model targets analysts and quantitative metrics; no onboarding screen, no people or teams.
reproduction: Submit the exact employee brief, professional but playful, Refined and Inventive.
issues.rootCause: Substring archetype detection rewards incidental dashboard/technical words; planner substitutes fixed telemetry screens and ignores recommended domain screens.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Semantically unrelated Gold resources fill required roles
issues.expected: Each role resolves to a compatible working resource.
issues.actual: Marketing value proposition and CTA become three-pane shells; dashboard metrics become Nav Tree / Visual Canvas / Inspector; grammar panes duplicate across all screen types.
reproduction: Inspect each direction and Workbench screens.
issues.rootCause: Role matching accepts grammar categories and falls back to every Gold resource; screen roles union application grammar roles irrespective of screen class.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Generated product inherits resource demo content
issues.expected: Brand, copy and sample records match the submitted objective, with sample data identified.
issues.actual: Tessellate marketing text, fake testimonials and ingestion/incidents/CPU/token data appear in employee product.
reproduction: Open settings and dashboard in Workbench.
issues.rootCause: Composition creates only a title prop, leaving domain-specific resource defaults intact.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Repeated composition overwrites project identity
issues.expected: Separate briefs create separate persisted projects while explicit seeds remain deterministic.
issues.rootCause: UI reuses fixed default seed as persisted project identity.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Direction previews are too small to inspect
issues.expected: Readable previews with screen navigation and distinct structural direction.
issues.actual: Three tiny clipped/scaled marketing heroes conceal the rest of the product; all use same hero content.
reproduction: Inspect all three previews at desktop and mobile.
issues.rootCause: Fixed miniature frame without accessible full direction preview or screen selector.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Reload silently discards project edits
issues.expected: Edits, locks and local overrides survive reload.
issues.actual: After recompose, replacement and Surprise, reload returns the initial manifest with no locks or edits.
reproduction: Lock a section, Recompose, Replace, Surprise.
issues.rootCause: Shell loads initial localStorage snapshot; mutations are not persisted.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Standalone export fails a clean build
issues.expected: ZIP installs, builds and runs without repository packages.
issues.actual: npm install succeeds, npm run build fails: gradient-fill is not assignable to AreaChartVariant.
reproduction: Replace overview header with offered area-chart.
issues.rootCause: Replacement uses a fabricated sample catalogue with variants that do not exist in canonical resource source.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Replacement offers incompatible resource
issues.expected: Candidates satisfy the semantic role and hard constraints using the actual Gold catalogue.
issues.actual: Only area-chart is offered for entity-profile-header; no meaningful candidate preview.
issues.rootCause: Hardcoded four-resource catalogue and permissive same-section-type match override semantics.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Replacement previews are synthetic drawings
issues.expected: Candidate displays its actual renderer and content.
issues.actual: Generic chart bars, grey rectangles or fake dollar metric replace actual candidate components.
reproduction: Open Replace and inspect its candidates.
issues.rootCause: ResourceVisualPreview draws mock graphics instead of canonical renderer.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Compare uses unrelated financial project
issues.expected: Compare targets the initial checkpoint of this exact project.
issues.actual: Apex Financial Intelligence is comparison baseline for employee brief.
issues.rootCause: setManifest resets history but retains sample-project checkpoint.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Blend invents a financial source direction
issues.expected: Blend uses an actual saved direction of the current brief or truthfully requires one.
issues.actual: Source B is a renamed sample fintech manifest with fabricated DNA.
issues.rootCause: BlendModal constructs createSampleProject rather than loading composition siblings.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Toolbar modes do not open corresponding inspector
issues.expected: Style, Motion and Content display the appropriate controls.
issues.actual: Top mode changes but right inspector remains Intent.
reproduction: Click each top mode after opening Workbench.
issues.rootCause: setActiveMode only sets activeMode, not activeRightTab.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Unnamed Workbench and direction controls
issues.expected: Every interactive control has an accessible name.
issues.actual: Axe critical button-name and label failures (7 Workbench ranges, 3 direction ranges).
reproduction: Run unsuppressed Axe on Compose directions and Workbench.
issues.rootCause: Range controls lack linked labels; layer expanders and default sample buttons lack names.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Selection and lock tiles are not keyboard controls
issues.expected: Keyboard users can select page/layer and toggle locks.
issues.actual: Clickable div rows and lock tiles are omitted from tab order.
reproduction: Tab through Layers and Locks inspector.
issues.rootCause: Click handlers use generic divs without keyboard semantics.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Workbench mixes unreadable dark and light chrome
issues.expected: Calm coherent shell with readable project title and inspector.
issues.actual: Near-white title on light toolbar and mixed dark/light areas; mobile canvas begins with huge empty shell panes.
issues.rootCause: Dark variants apply via preference without coherent explicit theme tokens; resource shell fallback compounds unusable canvas.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Mobile omits primary editing controls
issues.expected: Primary modes, replacement, export and viewport operations remain usable.
issues.actual: Mobile Inspect includes only Intent, Style and Locks; Resource, Content, Motion and Export missing.
issues.rootCause: Separate MobileWorkbench duplicates a restricted subset of desktop controls.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Audit score implies unverified accessibility
issues.expected: Audit distinguishes manifest heuristics from measured runtime compliance.
issues.actual: Accessibility 20/20 and responsive 15/15 despite critical and serious Axe failures.
issues.rootCause: Audit labels heuristic checks as compliance and does not explain measurement limits.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Surprise provides no change explanation
issues.expected: Visible explanation accurately reports mutations and preserved locks.
issues.actual: Change occurs but user sees no explanation.
issues.rootCause: Returned operation rationale is not surfaced in shell.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: 430px canvas preset missing
issues.expected: All requested device widths can be selected.
issues.rootCause: DevicePreset omits 430 and toolbar repeats restricted list.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Resource preview silently renders Button
issues.expected: Area chart detail displays its actual chart.
issues.actual: iframe shows button despite chart title and source.

console.text: An iframe which has both allow-scripts and allow-same-origin for its sandbox attribute can escape its sandboxing.

issues.rootCause: PreviewHost selects fallback component instead of full canonical registry.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Use in Workbench ignores selected resource
issues.expected: Chosen resource opens in a real new or current project with that resource.

console.text: An iframe which has both allow-scripts and allow-same-origin for its sandbox attribute can escape its sandboxing.

issues.rootCause: Workbench bootstrap ignores resource URL parameter.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Header Search click opens nothing
issues.expected: Click opens a usable search palette, Escape closes and restores focus.
issues.actual: No modal or search input appears.
issues.rootCause: SiteHeader mounts CommandPalette without isOpen; palette internal state starts closed.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Sign in link mislabels local Workbench
issues.expected: Navigation reflects actual unauthenticated staging behavior.
issues.actual: Sign in opens local Workbench without sign-in.
issues.rootCause: Static header label implies unavailable authentication flow.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Homepage mosaic links refer to nonexistent resources
issues.expected: Every resource link resolves to its actual catalogue record.
issues.rootCause: Static slug strings refer to legacy sample resources absent from324 catalogue.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Homepage claims measured perfect accessibility
issues.expected: Public claims are supported and clearly distinguish illustration.
issues.actual: Audit100/100 AACompliant and zero-debt accessibility appear despite captured serious failures.
issues.rootCause: Hardcoded demonstration score presented without qualification.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Shared muted text fails contrast
issues.expected: Normal text meets WCAG AA in each theme.
issues.actual: Serious Axe color-contrast failures: homepage36, Explore52, Compose56, Workbench19 nodes.
reproduction: Run Axe without disabling contrast on all major routes.
issues.rootCause: Muted#8B8F97 and opacity reductions are too light on paper; dark/light hardcoded combinations fail.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Sites static runtime drops security headers
issues.expected: Deployment preserves declared CSP, nosniff, referrer and frame policies.
issues.actual: Live responses contain none of the headers specified in _headers.
reproduction: Inspect live HTTP response headers for document and catalogue.
issues.rootCause: Sites native static hosting does not interpret Cloudflare Pages _headers.
issues.remediation: Pending root-cause remediation and deployed verification.

issues.title: Library Apply does not replace a resource
issues.expected: The operation changes the actual validated project without fabricated refs or identity collisions.
issues.actual: Apply KPI Metric Card changes the selected layout title to Active Metric but keeps its original resource/subtree.
issues.rootCause: Hardcoded legacy library fabricates four entries; Apply calls updateNodeProps rather than a resource mutation.
issues.remediation: Canonical resource replacement, unique subtree IDs and shared state checks. Local implementation is awaiting deployed re-audit.

issues.title: Duplicating a screen duplicates every node identity
issues.expected: The operation changes the actual validated project without fabricated refs or identity collisions.
issues.actual: Export contains 77 nodes but only 67 unique node IDs after duplicating Marketing Home.
issues.rootCause: PagesTab deep-clones the tree without allocating node IDs.
issues.remediation: Canonical resource replacement, unique subtree IDs and shared state checks. Local implementation is awaiting deployed re-audit.

acceptance: NOT ACCEPTED: remediation and deployed re-audit pending
